mainEntity.name: What are some popular design trends for modern bathrooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Modern bathroom design trends often focus on creating a spa-like, minimalist, and functional space. Popular elements include large-format tiles, walk-in showers with frameless glass enclosures, and freestanding tubs. Natural materials like wood and stone, along with neutral color palettes, are favored for a serene ambiance. Smart technology, such as heated floors, motion-sensing lighting, and digital shower controls, is also gaining popularity. Floating vanities and integrated storage solutions help maintain a clean and uncluttered look.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular modern bathroom trends include minimalist designs, walk-in showers, freestanding tubs, natural materials, neutral colors, smart technology, and floating vanities.
